title: Paul Victor Mathey
content: Paul Victor Mathey (1844 —1929) once said: "Each time I paint I throw myself into the water in order to learn swimming." (The quote is also attributed to Edouard Manet.)Felicien Rops in his workshop by Paul Mathey, c. 1888He learned painting and engraving at the École nationale supérieure des Beaux-Arts of Paris in the workshops of painters Léon Cogniet, Isidore Pils and Alexis-Joseph Mazerolle.Paul Mathey, Portrait of Ernest Ange Duez (1876)He began to exhibit at the Salon de Paris in 1868 and became a versatile artist, earning an income from portrait painting while also painting landscapes, still lifes, and other subjects.--Paul Mathey on WikipediaVideo on Mathey by Gammel / Lack
